purpose: Review the completed March 2026 RBA Financial Stability Review as the first Analysis FINANCIAL_STABILITY_REPORT specimen, preserving the distinction between prior institutional baseline and expectation, changed risk conditions and surprise, common geopolitical drivers and event causality, and exact canonical release time versus market-measurement precision.

selection_rationale: AL repaired and live-verified the RBA FSR monitor-to-canonical relationship, so the upstream source/change boundary is now clean.
The specimen is the first FINANCIAL_STABILITY_REPORT available for reviewed Analysis and therefore adds an object class not yet represented.
The October 2025 Review supplies a useful prior institutional baseline but not a March 2026 forecast; AM therefore tests the distinction between changed assessment and genuine surprise.

The March publication sits inside an unusually contaminated market environment dominated by Middle East conflict, oil, a two-day-old RBA rate hike, labour data and multiple global central-bank decisions; AM therefore tests common-driver versus event-causality discipline.
The remaining market-structure canonical gap is not filled mechanically because queue or histogram completion is not the project objective.
selection.hold_rationale: The remaining completed anchors remain a choice set. AM selects financial-stability analysis for event-object and causal-discipline novelty, not FIFO completion or quota filling.

schema_decision.reason: Existing Analysis vocabulary supports OFFICIAL_PRIOR_GUIDANCE, NOT_ESTABLISHED surprise, empty market movement, COMMON_DRIVER_CONTEXT, NOT_A_CAUSAL_CLAIM, PLAUSIBLE_WATCH_ITEM second-order effects and explicit falsifiers. Exact market-series contract remains unpopulated because no rights-cleared independent timestamp series is required for this specimen.

descendant_test_repairs.historical_checkpoint_preserved: AJ exact transform remains v0.10 / 14 reviews, v0.10 / 54 evidence and 12 reviewed event types.
descendant_test_repairs.live_descendant_repair: Live reviewed-count and event-type-diversity assertions become lower bounds while the AJ occurrence and PHYSICAL_RISK_WINDOW contribution remain exact.

descendant_test_repairs.historical_checkpoint_preserved: AL plan postcondition remains Analysis v0.10 / 14 at the monitor-only transaction boundary.
descendant_test_repairs.live_descendant_repair: Live Analysis version and review count may advance beyond the AL boundary while AL's exact-series-zero and protected-Analysis mutation contract remain enforced.
